clue.text: Faithful, but getting new man into bed

indicators.note: the bed is getting something put into it, so the bed word wraps around what follows

blocks.note: N is the standard abbreviation for new
any man's name will do; here Stan
a cot is a small bed

explanation.surface: A partner stays loyal even though a new man has ended up in their bed.
explanation.walkthrough: Crosswords often let 'man' stand for any short man's name; the bed is a child's one, and it takes both pieces inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A constant friend is steadfast and loyal, so the adjective is a straightforward synonym here.

clue.text: Seaman's union circumventing ban

indicators.note: to circumvent is to go round something, so the union word goes around the seaman

blocks.note: first half of TU, the trade union abbreviation
AB is an able seaman; the 's is just 'is'
second half of TU, the trade union abbreviation

explanation.surface: A sailors' trade union finds a way round a prohibition.
explanation.walkthrough: TU, for trade union, wraps around AB, the able seaman: T-AB-U.
explanation.definitionFit: Tabu is a variant spelling of taboo, a social or religious prohibition on something.

clue.text: Record subsuming records all about the truth

indicators.note: to subsume is to take something inside, so the first record holds the plural records
about means turned round, and all says the whole combination is turned

blocks.note: a log is a written record
EPs are extended-play records

explanation.surface: A diary entry about a pile of old vinyl that tells it like it is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'All about' turns the whole thing round only after the plural records are inside the single one.
explanation.definitionFit: Gospel truth is an idiom for something wholly reliable, so the word alone can mean the plain truth.

clue.text: Name used by Swiss skaters?

blocks.note: surface reading: a nickname or brand that skaters in Switzerland go by
setter's reading: what skaters in the Swiss capital would glide on is Bern's ice, and run together that is a woman's name

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as BERN plus ICE: Bern is the Swiss capital, and its frozen rinks are what local skaters use.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a female first name, matching the plain sense of the opening word, while splitting it gives a frozen surface in the Swiss capital.

clue.text: Class in the grass given new constitution

indicators.note: the class word sits inside the grass word

blocks.note: first part of REED, a tall grass
a form is a school class
end of REED, a tall grass

explanation.surface: Schoolchildren sent out among the reeds come back transformed.
explanation.walkthrough: FORM goes inside REED. In British schools a class is often called a form.
explanation.definitionFit: Something reformed has been remade or restructured, as a body given a new constitution is.

clue.text: They sleep when it's absurdly bright in nests

definitions.text: They sleep when it's absurdly bright in nests

indicators.note: something absurd is all over the place, so these letters are jumbled
the jumbled word sits inside the word for nests

blocks.note: first letter of NIDS, a nid being a nest
the six letters rearranged
rest of NIDS, a nid being a nest

explanation.surface: Some birds doze in their nests while the sun is ridiculously strong.
explanation.walkthrough: A rearranged BRIGHT goes inside NIDS. The whole clue also describes the answer: nocturnal birds sleep through bright daylight.
explanation.definitionFit: Night birds such as owls are active after dark and roost through the day, which the whole clue describes.

clue.text: A very long way to analyse words and a number

blocks.note: to parse is to analyse a sentence grammatically
C is the Roman numeral for 100

explanation.surface: A long journey spent doing grammar and arithmetic.
explanation.definitionFit: A parsec is an astronomical unit of distance, about 3.26 light years, so truly a very long way.

clue.text: Inactive business partner swallowing bone

indicators.note: what swallows takes something inside, so the partner word holds the bone word

blocks.note: first part of CO-MATE, a business partner
os is Latin for bone, used in anatomy
end of CO-MATE

explanation.surface: A sleeping partner in a firm gulps down a bone.
explanation.walkthrough: OS goes inside COMATE. A sleeping partner in a business does nothing, which fits the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone comatose is in a coma, deeply unconscious, and loosely means utterly inactive or sluggish.

clue.text: Prophet and priest getting God

blocks.note: Eli is the priest who raised Samuel in the Bible
Jah is a short form of Jehovah

explanation.surface: A holy man and a priest receiving the Almighty.
explanation.walkthrough: Eli is the crossword's favourite priest; JAH is a name for God, as in Rastafarian usage.
explanation.definitionFit: Elijah is an Old Testament prophet, taken up to heaven in a chariot of fire.

clue.text: Water drowned second biblical brother

indicators.note: something drowned is under the water, so the water word surrounds it

blocks.note: first letter of EAU, French for water
S is the abbreviation for second
rest of EAU

explanation.surface: Somebody's sibling from scripture went under the water.
explanation.walkthrough: S sits inside EAU, the French for water that crosswords borrow often.
explanation.definitionFit: Esau is Jacob's twin in Genesis, who sold his birthright for a bowl of stew.

clue.text: Know-all gets to paint Posh Spice's head somehow

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter
somehow means in some unspecified way, so the letters are arranged in some new way

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written
the first letter of Spice

explanation.surface: A smart alec sets about painting a pop star from the Spice Girls.
explanation.walkthrough: Posh Spice was Victoria Beckham's name in the 1990s girl group the Spice Girls; only Posh is used whole.
explanation.definitionFit: A pansophist claims universal knowledge, from Greek for all-wise, so they are a know-all.

clue.text: Right place to find variety of leaf

indicators.note: a variety is a different form, so the letters take another form

blocks.note: R is the abbreviation for right
taken as written

explanation.surface: Advice on the proper spot to hunt for an unusual kind of leaf.
explanation.definitionFit: In botany a carpel, the female organ of a flower, is regarded as a modified leaf.

clue.text: Negotiator has what makes ticker tick without energy

indicators.note: the clue says the negotiator, once it is without energy, is the heart device, so energy must be put inside

blocks.note: first letter of PACEMAKER, the heart device
E is the physics symbol for energy
rest of PACEMAKER

explanation.surface: A diplomat with a heart condition relies on a device, minus any vigour.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue works backwards: take E out of PEACEMAKER and you get PACEMAKER. So the negotiator 'has' the heart device when without energy. A ticker is slang for the heart.
explanation.definitionFit: A peacemaker brokers agreement between opposing parties, which is the work of a negotiator.

clue.text: Renewed success for compiler with degree stuffing bird

indicators.note: stuffing goes inside, so the compiler and degree are packed into the bird

blocks.note: first part of COCK, a male bird
the setter refers to themselves
a Bachelor of Arts degree
rest of COCK

explanation.surface: A setter with a university degree stuffs a chicken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Compiler' is the setter of the puzzle, so the first person pronoun; a cock is a male bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A comeback is a return to former success after a period of decline, as with a recovering sports star.

clue.text: Feature on board in the Channel

indicators.note: on board means on a ship, and ship's letters go round what is aboard

blocks.note: first S of SS, steamship
a trait is a characteristic feature
second S of SS

explanation.surface: Something notable seen aboard a ship crossing between England and France.
explanation.walkthrough: TRAIT sits inside SS, the usual crossword steamship. 'On board' looks like a location in the surface; it is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The English Channel is a narrow sea passage, and the Straits of Dover form its narrowest part.

clue.text: Works on ways to include bible translation

indicators.note: the ways word includes the bible abbreviation inside itself

blocks.note: first part of TRAILS, paths or ways
the Authorised Version of the Bible
rest of TRAILS

explanation.surface: A scholar labours at routes for spreading a Bible translation.
explanation.walkthrough: AV goes inside TRAILS. The Authorised Version is the King James Bible of 1611.
explanation.definitionFit: Travail means painful hard labour, so the plural verb travails means works hard, toils.

clue.text: Notice habit of speech

blocks.note: an ad is a notice in a paper
a habit is a style of dress, as a nun's

explanation.surface: Someone observes a particular verbal tic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Habit of speech' reads as a phrase, but habit is wordplay and speech alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An address is a formal speech delivered to an audience, such as a keynote.

clue.text: Poet almost keeping America in a state of excitement

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the poet loses a final letter
to keep something is to hold it, so the shortened poet holds the country

blocks.note: start of SPENSER, the Elizabethan poet
the United States
rest of SPENSER

explanation.surface: A poet nearly holds the attention of America, which is thrilled.
explanation.walkthrough: Edmund Spenser wrote The Faerie Queene; lose his last R and wrap the rest around US.
explanation.definitionFit: Suspense is anxious, excited uncertainty while waiting to see what happens.

clue.text: Love duet is getting repetitive

indicators.note: getting here means becoming, so the letters become something else

blocks.note: love is nil in tennis, shaped like O
taken as written

explanation.surface: A romantic song for two is starting to grate through repetition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tedious is dull and wearisome, often because it is the same thing over and over.

clue.text: Cheap accommodation for government?

blocks.note: first meaning: the cheapest passenger quarters on a ship
second meaning: the act of steering, an old sense of governing or directing

explanation.walkthrough: Government comes from the Greek for steering a ship, so the act of steering is a kind of governing.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the lowest-fare quarters on a liner and, archaically, the steering or direction of something.

clue.text: Plough furrow up - it's not very exciting

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the words are read from bottom to top

blocks.note: to dig is to turn the soil
a rut is a furrow or groove

explanation.surface: Ploughing a field and digging furrows is pretty boring work.
explanation.definitionFit: Turgid prose is swollen and pompous, and so tediously heavy going rather than lively.

clue.text: Growth is said to follow popular demand

indicators.note: is said means spoken, so the growth word is taken by its sound

blocks.note: in means fashionable, popular
a cyst is a growth; spelt to match its sound

explanation.surface: A lump that is reported to come after the well-liked one.
explanation.walkthrough: The growth comes second though the clue mentions it first: 'to follow popular' puts it after IN.
explanation.definitionFit: To insist is to demand firmly, refusing to accept refusal.

clue.text: Scripture on film raised and promoted by 13?

indicators.note: in a down entry, raised means lifted upward, so read bottom to top

blocks.note: cine as in cine-film
RI is religious instruction, scripture in school

explanation.surface: A religious film is boosted and backed by the 13 answer.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' puts RI below CINE; the whole is then reversed. 13 is PEACEMAKER, so the definition is 'peaceable'.
explanation.definitionFit: Irenic means aiming at peace and conciliation, the attitude a peacemaker promotes.

clue.text: One of the first people (perhaps first) to study a parasite

indicators.note: the first of a word is its opening letter

blocks.note: the first letter of perhaps
to read a subject is to study it
taken as written
a mite is a tiny parasitic arachnid

explanation.surface: A pioneer of humanity may have been the first to research a parasite.
explanation.walkthrough: The bracket reads as an aside, but it hides the P. 'One of the first people' cleverly echoes the 'first' that picks it.
explanation.definitionFit: A pre-Adamite is someone believed to have lived before Adam, so among humanity's earliest people.

clue.text: Chopper beginning to leap and jump

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter

blocks.note: an axe chops wood
the first letter of leap

explanation.surface: A woodcutter's tool starts to leap and spring about.
explanation.definitionFit: An axel is a figure-skating leap with one and a half turns, named after Axel Paulsen.

clue.text: The end of the New Testament

indicators.note: of here means taken out of, so the letters come from inside the following words

blocks.note: the letters sit in the middle of Testament

explanation.surface: A remark on how the Christian scriptures finish.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue is also literally true: the New Testament's final word is the answer, so the whole reads as a description.
explanation.definitionFit: Said at the close of a prayer, the word marks its finish, so it can stand for the end.

clue.text: Sort of gland that's at home in ring

indicators.note: the home word sits inside the ring word

blocks.note: first letter of PEAL, a ring of bells
someone at home is in
rest of PEAL

explanation.surface: A gland that is comfortable inside a ring.
explanation.definitionFit: The pineal gland is a small endocrine organ in the brain that produces melatonin.

clue.text: 13's one quatrain, perhaps, means everything

blocks.note: 13 is PEACEMAKER; the United Nations is a peacemaker
I is the Roman numeral one
a quatrain, a four-line stanza, is an example of verse

explanation.surface: A peacemaker's single four-line poem says it all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps' marks a quatrain as just one kind of verse.
explanation.definitionFit: The universe is the totality of all existing matter and space, that is, everything there is.
